name: Michael Jackson Eating Popcorn
look: A dim movie-theater still of Michael Jackson in a red leather jacket, eating popcorn with wide, glowing eyes and an eager, delighted expression. A smiling woman sits just behind him in the dark.
use: A reaction for eagerly watching drama unfold. Posted when an argument, scandal or messy situation starts, meaning the poster is sitting back to enjoy the show instead of taking part.
